column2: Viper .22
A two-shot over-under derringer chambered in .22 SR, 3D printed in plastic.
Small enough to hide in a palm. Two barrels, two chances; after that, run.
Blunderpipe
A sawn-off double-barrel shotgun chambered in 10mm, with a dark red grip and forend.
Cut down well past what Security tolerates. In the Lower Levels, it settles arguments at point-blank range.
Sentinel 10
A machine pistol chambered in 10mm, in polymer and steel, with its magazine in front of the trigger.
A design older than the station, brought up to date by Lower Level gunsmiths.
Hornet
A personal defense weapon chambered in .22 SR, 3D printed in plastic, with a top-mounted magazine and a folding stock.
Comes out of the printer in one piece. A bit of sanding and it is ready to sell.
Pile Driver
A long-barrel revolver chambered in 10mm, with a wooden grip. Huge power, brutal recoil.
Six shots. Most customers buy it for the noise.
Longsight
A bullpup carbine chambered in 10mm, with a built-in scope and the magazine behind the grip.
A long barrel in a compact gun. The most accurate weapon Vex has ever hung on her board.
Aurora
A gold-plated revolver chambered in 10mm, with a pearl grip.
A collector's piece no chip can print. Only ever found in sealed crates, and nobody knows who fills them.
Malorian Arms 3516
A custom-made power pistol chambered in 10mm: chrome slide, black frame, skeletonized red grip.
One of a kind. It belonged to a rockerboy who hated the corps; word is it hits even harder than he sang.
Holographic Sight
A holographic sight that projects a teal reticle for quick target acquisition.
2x Scope
A 2x magnifying scope for the rail. Very accurate, but bulky.
Muzzle Brake
A muzzle device that vents escaping gases to reduce recoil.
Heavy Suppressor
A long, heavy multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire and steadies the muzzle.
Angled Grip
An angled foregrip for long guns, designed to improve handling.
Tactical Light
An underbarrel light that lights up the target, improving aim in the dark.
Extended 10mm Magazine
An extended polymer 10mm magazine for magazine-fed 10mm guns.
Folding Stock
A folding steel stock compatible with long guns, designed to improve recoil handling.
Polished Slide
A mirror finish for the slide. Purely cosmetic. Cannot be combined with Gold Inlay.
Match Trigger
A trigger tuned to the gram that reduces pull weight and improves accuracy.
Gold Inlay
Gold threads inlaid in the metal. Spectacular. Cannot be combined with Polished Slide.
Reinforced Frame
Steel reinforcements for the frame that improve resistance to failure under stress.
Overpressure Kit
Reworked springs and chamber for hotter loads. More stopping power, at the cost of wear.
Bayonet
A steel blade that clips under the muzzle of long guns. Adds stopping power and style, but weighs the muzzle down. Also sells as a melee weapon.
Reloaded .22 Ammunition
A handful of .22 SR rounds, reloaded by hand from salvaged casings. Cheaper, and almost as good.
Reloaded 10mm Ammunition
A handful of 10mm rounds, reloaded in Vex's back room. Every round has its little quirk.
10mm Steel-Core Ammunition
A handful of 10mm rounds with hardened steel tips. Armor-piercing, and very illegal.
Ammo Crate
A sealed crate with no label. Holds 4 to 6 .22 or 10mm rounds. Double-click to open.
It rattles when you shake it.
Parts Crate
A crate of spare gun parts. Holds 2 gun attachments, with a 15% chance of a rare one. Double-click to open.
Spare parts that "fell off a truck".
Sealed Weapon Crate
A sealed weapon crate. Holds one random gun in a random condition (3% brand new), with a 2% chance of a gold-plated Aurora, and a 25% chance of a round of ammo with the gun. Double-click to open.
Vex never opens these herself. "Bad luck", she says.
Collector's Crate
A collector's crate. Holds a brand-new high-end gun and 2 rare attachments, with a 15% chance of an Aurora. Double-click to open.
Black velvet and gold clasps. Comes with a certificate nobody reads.

Vex Contract I

Vex will put you on her list of gunsmiths. Her armory will sell you the Viper .22, its chip and her precision attachments. Her stock only shows while you hold Weapon Permit I or 20 Black Market Reputation. She gives you a lucky cat once you reach 20 Black Market Reputation and takes it back if it drops below 0.
You have already signed this contract with Vex.
Vex Contract II

Vex will open her workshop to you: the Sentinel 10, the Blunderpipe and their chips, steel-core ammunition, the weapon crate, and the Metal Printer and CNC Modules. Requires Vex Contract I, and Weapon Permit II or 40 Black Market Reputation. She gives you a lucky cat once you reach 40 Black Market Reputation and takes it back if it drops below 20.
You have already signed this contract with Vex.
Vex Contract III

Vex will give you the run of her back room: the Hornet, the Pile Driver, the Longsight and their chips, her best attachments and the collector's crate. Requires Vex Contract II, and Weapon Permit III or 60 Black Market Reputation. She gives you a lucky cat once you reach 60 Black Market Reputation and takes it back if it drops below 40.

Gunsmith's Manual
A handy manual that contains all the information on Vex's contracts, gun permits and gun printing.
Gunsmith's Manual
Vex and her Contracts
Vex visits your Store on day 3, then opens her armory at night. Her contracts are sold in the network.
Contract I (250): the Viper and precision attachments.
Contract II (500): Sentinel, Blunderpipe, metal and CNC modules.
Contract III (800): Hornet, Pile Driver, Longsight.
A contract only counts while you are covered for its rank.
Getting Covered
Gun permit
Security 20 / 50 / 80: legal guns
Black Market
Reputation 20 / 40 / 60: contraband
A permit, or one of Vex's cats, in the display case brings gun buyers.
No permit: Vex's lucky cats (white, black, gold: tiers I to III) draw her buyers (+25%), as often as a permit.
Each gun sold without a permit adds evidence; at 100, a fine or an arrest. The fix: Wild's Fixers (network), one level per tier.
Printing
Vex sells the 3D printer from contract I.
The Viper and the Hornet print whole, in plastic.
Frame + gun part = a gun. Frames need the metal and CNC modules.
The purer the metal ingots, the better the gun: up to +100% stats.
Precision Nozzle: +20%. Serial CNC: 2 frames per print.

Warden-10
A non-lethal 10mm pistol with an orange frame, built for rubber rounds.
It stops without killing, and Security lets anyone sell it. A gunsmith can still give it its teeth back.
Riotbreaker
A non-lethal short double-barreled 10mm riot gun with an orange grip and forend.
Patrols use it to break up crowds in the Lower Level. Its barrels take much worse rounds.
Lethal Conversion Kit
A barrel and stiffer springs for the Warden-10 and the Riotbreaker. Once fitted, the gun fires live rounds and becomes contraband for good, even if the kit comes out (Weapon Permit I covers it).
